thread:
Morgan R: Quick flag 1: ran into a confusing UX on eval runs when large reruns hit throttling. The error modal just shows raw 429 text: `Rate limit exceeded`. Users get stuck.
Devin L: Is that coming straight from the API?
Morgan R: Yeah — frontend surfaces the payload. No friendly guidance.
Sofia P: Steps to repro?
Morgan R: Start a rerun of ~150 cases, trigger batching + rate limiter, then click Retry on a failed chunk. Modal pops with 429 and no next steps. deploy-bot shows a bunch of backoffs.
deploy-bot: 429 events captured: 2026-06-12T18:22:10Z pool:dedicated-gpu-a retry_allowed:false
Ashley M: UX thought: "Retry" implies immediate action. If backend says wait, we should either show an ETA and auto-retry or disable Retry and explain why.
Karen S: Accessibility: modal updates need aria-live and predictable focus. If Retry gets disabled mid-flow, SRs should be notified.
Sofia P: Copy idea 1: "We're temporarily busy. We'll retry this batch in ~30s — no action needed." CTAs: Close + View run details.
Sofia P: Copy idea 2 (if letting users enqueue retry): Primary: Close. Secondary: "Queue retry (may be delayed)" with helper text: "Requests may be delayed to avoid overloading the model pool. See scheduled retries in Run History."
Devin L: We sometimes return a `retry_after` header. Can surface that. If absent, estimate with backoff (start 30s, then 2m).
Ashley M: Microcopy: avoid jargon like "rate limit". Use "busy" or "processing backlog".
Karen S: Keyboard: ensure both CTAs are reachable; if Retry disabled, focus should move to Close. For screen readers, announce retry ETA.
Morgan R: Also issue with context loss: when some chunks succeed and others are queued, modal only shows errors. We should show summary counts: succeeded / queued / failed.
Sofia P: Proposed modal layout:
```
[Header] Some batches are delayed
[Body] 12 processed, 3 queued for retry in ~30s, 1 failed. We'll retry automatically up to 3 times.
[Primary CTA] Close
[Secondary CTA] Queue retry (may be delayed)
[Link] View run details
```
Devin L: Backend work: expose `scheduled_retry_at`, `retry_count`, and `retry_after` in run status API so UI can render ETAs and counts.
Ashley M: I'll mock two flows: auto-retry UI and manual-queue UI. Also design a small inline pill for run list: `retrying` with live countdown. Will check contrast and scaling.
Karen S: ARIA items: announce count changes via aria-live polite; provide `aria-hidden` toggles for animated countdowns so SRs aren't spammed. Expose scheduled retry time to AT users as "Retry scheduled in X seconds".
Morgan R: Product decision: how many auto-retries do we show? Backend caps at 3. We should explicitly say that in copy: "We'll try up to 3 times." Any objections?
Sofia P: Fine by me. Final helper line candidate: "We'll automatically retry this batch up to 3 times. Next attempt in ~30s."
Devin L: I'll file an infra ticket to add scheduled_retry_at + retry_count to the run status endpoint and make retry_after available in chunk metadata. @Karen S can you list the exact ARIA attributes you need?
Karen S: Yep. I'll post a short checklist: aria-live roles, focus management, keyboard order, and `aria-hidden` strategy for animated elements.
Ashley M: Mock frames dropping into #design in a couple hours :paintbrush: Will include contrast values and keyboard flows.
Morgan R: Copy owner? @Sofia P please finalize microcopy. I'll own the product decision on cap visibility.
Sofia P: I'll take it.
Morgan R: TL;DR action items:
- Devin: API: add scheduled_retry_at, retry_count, retry_after per-chunk.
- Ashley: designs (auto + manual) + inline pill + contrast check.
- Karen: ARIA checklist + keyboard tests.
- Sofia: finalize microcopy.
- Morgan: confirm messaging around retry cap and announce in UX sync.
Morgan R: If anyone sees other weird behavior during reruns, paste logs here. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
